selected_problem: Fresh-main regression probing of the newly centralized credential-like path classifier found that it only matched sensitive names at the end of a path. As a result, paths nested below a credential-like directory such as secrets/token.txt, credentials/service.json, or even a directory named .env.local remained classifiable as non-sensitive and could still enter automatic cognition context.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT through its singular evidence-rich bottleneck gate. This is a narrow regression directly adjacent to the previous closure, not a reason to force a mode rotation.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. Selection and routing come from replaying committed DWAC scoring/router contracts over fresh-main code and direct regression evidence while the hosted Developer Execution Runtime remained transiently unavailable.

pre_fix_reproduction.nested_secret_directory: EXPECTED FAILURE reproduced on canonical base: isCredentialLikePath('secrets/token.txt') returned false and contextBundle returned synthetic TOKEN content from that path.
pre_fix_reproduction.cause: The credential regex ended with $, so credential-like basenames were protected only when they were the final component rather than any path segment.

changes: The existing centralized SECRET_PATH policy now treats a credential-like component as sensitive when followed by either '/' or end-of-path.
This preserves all previous protected final names while extending the same policy through nested paths such as secrets/token.txt, credentials/service.json, and .env.local/nested.txt.
No new secret-scanning subsystem, provider behavior, product form, or architecture was introduced.
truth_boundaries: This closes path-segment coverage for the existing credential-like naming policy; it does not perform content-based secret detection in benignly named regular files.
Hard-link aliases remain outside this focused closure.
Validation workspace confinement remains a broader unresolved sovereignty boundary and was not disguised as solved here.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis and filesystem crash-level atomicity remain unresolved.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
